courses.overview: 由排程閘門、時間同步與可界定延遲連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect scheduled gates, synchronization and bounded latency to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 時間同步 PTP 網路
related.why: 可移植「流量需求合約」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from traffic contracts; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「流量需求合約」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from traffic contracts; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理排程閘門、時間同步與可界定延遲；「時間同步 PTP 網路」主要處理時戳、路徑不對稱與時鐘伺服，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes scheduled gates, synchronization and bounded latency; Precision Time Protocol networks emphasizes timestamps, path asymmetry and clock servos. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「時間敏感網路」與「時間同步 PTP 網路」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「時間感知閘門」的對照方法至「Ordinary clock」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Time-sensitive networking and Precision Time Protocol networks flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from time-aware gates to ordinary clocks, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 工控網路分區與隔離
related.why: 可移植「流量需求合約」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from traffic contracts; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.transfer: 可移植「流量需求合約」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的介面與版本。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from traffic contracts; both require traceable interfaces/versions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理排程閘門、時間同步與可界定延遲；「工控網路分區與隔離」主要處理OT 區域、通道與不中斷的防禦證據，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes scheduled gates, synchronization and bounded latency; Industrial-control network segmentation emphasizes ot zones, conduits and non-disruptive defensive evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「時間敏感網路」與「工控網路分區與隔離」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「時間感知閘門」的對照方法至「流矩陣」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Time-sensitive networking and Industrial-control network segmentation flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from time-aware gates to flow matrices, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

history.title: IEEE 時間敏感網路工作組
history.text: 本課的公開資料脈絡包括「IEEE 時間敏感網路工作組」與「IEEE 802.1AS 時間同步」。課程把介面和原理改寫為自行設定的對照練習，沒有重製文章、圖像或來源算例。
